findings.text: follow-on: the base arm's header reads "revision: f87f930c569dacd22be34464e6a2aa5e1fecb476", differing by one hex digit from the pre-fix head f87f930c569dacd22be34464e6a3aa5e1fecb476 the manifest records, and "git cat-file -t" refuses it as unknown; the log therefore cannot be resolved to the revision it ran at, and the base arm's identity rests on the manifest's JSON rather than on the artifact a reader opens.

follow-on: the assertion compares the row's ref against the same expression the test wrote into the fixture's plan-section-depends-on meta at :494, so both sides move together with the input and the assertion cannot fail by changing it; it guards the ref plumbing only, while the independent weight sits in the status and satisfied assertions at :509-511.

follow-on: the measure table's named-gate row reports the after arm as 81aa5716c with "64 passed" over the earlier five-file gate, an intermediate revision two rounds behind the delivered head; the delivered gate is 98 passed at dfb4cc138 over eight suites (after-runs-whole.log), so the landing record's headline figure does not describe the change being promoted.

VERDICT done_when: read at prompt.txt:101-102; the gate is recorded at after-runs-whole.log ("98 passed", bare EXIT=0 at dfb4cc138 over the node's test file plus the seven suites that read these views) and its base arm at baseline-runs-whole.log ("4 failed, 94 passed", EXIT=1 at the pre-fix head over the same eight files), and the node's own file asserts most clauses - section read in all four views (tests/test_a_row_is_compact_and_names_its_section.py:226), fields=["section"] accepted by all four (:233), a field a view lacks refused naming its fields (:260), a done section of an in-progress plan reading satisfied (:499 and :514); two clauses diverge from the done-when's literal wording and are recorded rather than met: the rows read the canonical section spelling where the done-when writes "s4" (disclosed at docs/evidence/fragments/the-mcp-answers-the-question-asked/a-row-is-compact-and-names-its-section.html:179-188), and the runs view keeps an empty declared field the done-when says is omitted (the coordinator's ruling, named in the manifest's blockers).
VERDICT write_paths: the dispatch fence (prompt.txt:69-75) grants six paths, and resume-1-advice.txt, resume-2-advice.txt and resume-5-advice.txt record the coordinator's later grants of reckon/crew/directory.py, reckon/crew/obligations.py and reckon/roadmap.py; git diff --stat 8c7e865d7 baa93ba53 lists exactly eight paths and no ninth, every one inside the manifest's orientation_write_paths.
VERDICT manifest: read; status complete, baseline_suite and after_suite carry literal placeholder-free commands, readable log paths and recorded failure ids, and negative_control_log names control-runs-row-whole.log, which ends with a bare EXIT=1 and three failing ids the head arm does not fail; the base arm's own log header names a revision that resolves to no object (see the first finding).
VERDICT diff: read commit by commit over the full node range 8c7e865d7..baa93ba53 - 15 commits, 8 files, 1082 insertions - of which the last five answer the previous review: ce3a705f6 builds the runs row whole so the view's own filters can read it, 2ab0b1f0f and 9c29a0d47 declare the obligations and directory vocabularies, dfb4cc138 serves the runs row whole and carries the live view's mine marker across the projection by run id, and baa93ba53 touches the evidence fragment only, stating the whole-row contract.
